release_notes: Enhanced logging system and UI improvements
changes: Added comprehensive logging to file and console (smart_assistant.log)
Version number moved to bottom left corner of main menu
Settings panel moved to bottom right corner of main menu
Environment selector moved from login screen to settings panel
Increased automation speed base timings for more visible speed control
Enhanced version comparison logging for update troubleshooting
Fixed Quick Links header (removed duplicate version display)
All automation delays now properly respect global speed multiplier
Added detailed logging for: startup, settings, updates, scans, downloads
